prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: approval design for Rakky Ride mobile Help & Support.
Primary request: ONE complete beautiful compact mobile screen, flat front-on screenshot, logical 390 x 844, no phone frame. Match a white-forward ride-hailing app: forest green actions, pale mint highlights, white/silver surfaces, charcoal typography, muted gray-green captions. Restrained Inter-like text, 15px header, 14px row and section titles, 13px captions. Utility outline icons16–18px inside 28–32px circles. Back control44–48px, action rows at least44px. No large illustrations, no giant headings, no gradients, no dark default.
Layout, in this exact hierarchy:
- Small ordinary phone status bar.
- Compact header with pale silver round back-arrow control and small title "Help & support". Thin silver divider. No long subtitle.
- A compact pale-mint welcome strip, around60px tall: small18px green headset inside32px white circle at left, title "How can we help?" at14–15px, short caption "Choose a topic below." at13px. No oversized hero.
- Heading "Helpful shortcuts" in14px.
- One white bordered group of THREE compact rows, each about52px high, subtle silver separators, small conventional outline icon inside a pale silver circle on left, 14px text and small right chevron:
  car/receipt outline: "Your trips & receipts"
  wallet outline: "Wallet & payments"
  profile outline: "Account & phone"
No extra row descriptions. These are shortcuts to existing app sections, not a fake ticket system.
- Heading "Quick answers" in14px.
- A separate white bordered accordion group with TWO compact collapsed rows, 44–48px touch targets, small gray plus at right:
  "Where can I find my receipt?"
  "Why is money held in my wallet?"
Do not show expanded text in this picture, and do not add a search box.
- A contact availability card in pale silver with small32px headset circle at left and title "Contact Rakky Ride" in14px. Below in13px exact text "Support contact details are being set up." Then smaller13px muted "Support hours will be announced." A full-width44px outlined button with small refresh outline and exact label "Refresh contact details". This unavailable state is intentional: NO phone number, email address, active Call button, active Email button, live-chat control, response time or 24/7 claim.
- At bottom a compact white row with thin pale-red border, small red shield outline at left, title "Need urgent help?" in14px, caption "Open Safety Center" in13px and small red right chevron. This opens the already existing safety page; do not add an emergency call button here.
- Normal small home indicator at very bottom.
Composition: 16–20px page margins, 12px section gaps, compact consistent corners, all content fits within the screen without clipping. Use breathing space economically; keep text and art small. Icons should be conventional clear utility line icons, not emojis. One screen only.
Constraints: This is a design proposal, not implemented functionality. Reflect the actual unconfigured support-contact state honestly. No invented phone/email contacts, names, trip details, financial records, chat transcripts, ticket numbers, promises of resolution, community forums, new products, maps or promotional badges. Exact readable text. Keep urgent help visually distinct from ordinary contact support.
